newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares pushed up by Droga.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares pushed up by Droga.

text.p: Slovenian shares firmed 0.64 percent on Friday fuelled by an almost four percent rise in shares of food maker Droga.
"The buoyanct mood of the last three days also extended to trading today. The optimism in recent days has been based on domestic buying," one trader said.
* The SBI index rose 8.66 points to 1,361.95.
* Overall nine shares rose, six fell and 13 were unchanged.
* Food maker Droga rose 3.95 percent to 28,190 tolars on volume of 223 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
